svg.title: Laundry worker — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as laundry worker, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: Two folded linen pieces sit above a tapered laundry basket with three open slats. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a softly squared face.
